fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear.

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear.

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection

ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. 1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSON

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSON

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL.

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL.
