The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolv

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolv

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability.

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability.

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection

ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection and provenance

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection and provenance

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection and provenance classification

fix.summary:
The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection and provenance classification

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection and provenance classification are caller

The direction is coherent, but the submitted materials are not yet contract-complete authority. ADR 0010 permits an opt-in transport/persistence capability around one caller-selected invocation; it does not permit a role to record itself or the package to acquire routing. Current HEAD confirms the distinction: `src/role-runtime.ts` activates only the five roles, role Receipts terminate through their own tools, and `package.json`/the tarball expose only `extensions/role-runtime.ts` plus existing sources. `docs/development-closure.md` also makes exact Receipt identity, truth, and acceptance distinct. Amend the authority materials—not Souls—with the following minimum contract.

1. **Owner and public seam.** The package owns exactly one non-role Recorder at the outer invocation/session-persistence seam. It records one already caller-designated formal role invocation. It is not a model tool, Soul, role controller, submission tool, or workflow stage; it may not choose a role, dispatch another invocation, retry, route, count rounds, interpret a verdict, or close an issue. Expose one explicit opt-in Recorder entrypoint in the package’s actual git/local-install distribution (ADR 0009); the caller must designate the archive repository/root, a collision-free docket-relative identity, the one invocation, and any ephemeral input materials. Do not add a second hidden recording path. Exact CLI spelling and internal wiring are later design details, but those semantic inputs and the two outcomes below are public.

2. **Canonical evidence boundary.** “Complete” means the complete sanitized event record observable at that one parent Pi invocation boundary, from invocation start through termination/abort, together with its child-process outcome. It does not mean provider/network internals, private Reviewer child histories, a repository snapshot, or proof that every claim in the transcript is true. Preserve one canonical `session.jsonl`; one versioned, digest-bearing `manifest.json`; one mechanically extracted `receipt.json` only when an accepted lawful role-output tool result exists; `redactions.json` only when redaction occurred; and caller-designated external inputs that would otherwise disappear. The Receipt projection is the sole allowed deliberate duplication from JSONL. Do not create parallel prompt/tool/audit trees, per-role ledgers, catalogs, or resumable state.

3. **Repository references and ephemeral inputs.** A repository-resident input may be reference-only only when its exact bytes resolve at the recorded repository identity, full commit SHA, path, and digest. Dirty, untracked, mismatching, or otherwise non-resolvable bytes must be treated as ephemeral external input and sanitized/copied, or the archive must fail; a commit-plus-digest must not falsely imply resolvability. Input selection and provenance classification are caller
